exposure: Singletons of patients with prepregnancy diabetes
cohort: 26,604,392 live births and 155,214 stillbirths in the United States from 2015-2021
finding: The onset of the COVID-19 pandemic was associated with a transient decrease in obstetric intervention and a transient increase in perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: The onset of the COVID-19 pandemic was associated with a transient decrease in preterm labor induction or cesarean delivery.
